# Private Morocco Transfers (privatemoroccotransfers.com)

> Guaranteed fixed-price private transfers, airport pickups, and chauffeur services across Morocco.

## About the Service
- **Service Name:** Private Morocco Transfers
- [Official Website](https://www.privatemoroccotransfers.com)
- **WhatsApp Booking & Support:** +212 760 426 269 (Instant confirmation)
- **Fleet:** Modern Comfort Sedans (1–4 pax), Spacious Vans (5–7 pax, Mercedes Vito/V-Class), and VIP Minibuses (8–14 pax, Mercedes Sprinter).
- **Pricing Policy:** Flat rate per vehicle (never per person). All tolls, vehicle fuel, parking, and luggage handling are 100% included.
- **Deposit & Payment:** Zero prepayment or deposit needed for bookings of €300 (3,300 MAD) or less. Pay directly to the driver on arrival in EUR, MAD, USD, or GBP. 30% confirmation deposit for bookings exceeding €300.
- **Discounts:** 10% discount on all round-trip return transfers.
- **Airport Pickups:** Free flight delay monitoring and 45-minute terminal waiting with Meet & Greet name sign included.
- **Child Seats:** Certified infant car seats and child boosters provided free upon request.
